register.labelZh: BURST 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: burst out 可以表示某人毫無預兆地說話,並帶有強烈情緒。；burst out laughing、crying 或 singing 表示動作突然開始,而不是慢慢開始。；burst out of 和 burst through 可以描述人、動物、車輛、水或光線突然並有力地移動。；burst onto the scene 可以描述一名新歌手、球員、作家或產品突然引起大眾注意。
register.summaryEn: Burst out can show that somebody says something without warning and with strong feelings. Burst out laughing, crying or singing shows that the action starts suddenly rather than slowly. Burst out of and burst through can describe people, animals, vehicles, water or light moving quickly and forcefully. Burst onto the scene can describe a new singer, player, writer or product that suddenly attracts attention.
